locations.title: Locations
locations.description: French city names (Lyon), arrondissements (Paris 11e), postcodes (69003), departments (Rhône) or raw Bien'ici zone ids (-7444). Each is resolved through the site's own location search; the best match is logged. Leave empty to search all of France.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (EUR)
minPrice.description: Sale price or monthly rent in euros.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (EUR)
maxPrice.description: Sale price or monthly rent in euros.

minSurface.title: Minimum surface (m²)
minSurface.description: Minimum living surface in square metres.

maxSurface.title: Maximum surface (m²)
maxSurface.description: Maximum living surface in square metres.

minRooms.title: Minimum rooms (pièces)
minRooms.description: Minimum number of rooms (pièces, French count including living room).

energyClasses.title: DPE energy classes
energyClasses.description: Keep only listings whose DPE energy class is one of these. Leave empty for all classes (including listings without a DPE).

newBuild.title: New-build
newBuild.description: Include new-build programmes: any (default), only new builds, or exclude them.

publishedSince.title: Published since
publishedSince.description: Keep only listings first published at or after this moment: an ISO date (2026-10-01) or a relative period (24h, 7d, 2w, 1m). With the default sort (newest first) the run stops as soon as it reaches older listings, so daily runs are cheap.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Sort order of the site search. publicationDate (newest first) lets publishedSince stop the run early.

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Descending (default) or ascending for the chosen sort field.

maxResults.title: Maximum listings
maxResults.description: Stop after this many listings. The run cost is bounded by this number.

includeDescription.title: Include full description text
includeDescription.description: The agent's French description (often 500-2,000 characters). Turn off for smaller rows.

includePhotos.title: Include photo URLs
includePhotos.description: Adds a photos array with image URLs. The photo count is always included.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Listings per request to bienici.com (the site accepts up to 200). Requests are paced at one per second.

extraFilters.title: Extra raw filters
extraFilters.description: Additional keys merged into the site's own filters JSON for options not exposed above, for example {"hasTerrace": true, "maxPricePerSquareMeter": 6000, "minBedrooms": 2}. Keys here override the fields above.
